title: Critical Apache Roller, Axis Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
content_md: Two critical vulnerabilities in Apache software are being exploited in attacks, and CISA added one of them to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog on Wednesday. Apache Axis vulnerability exploited in attacks CVE-2026-90436 , disclosed on November 6, is an unsafe reflection vulnerability in Apache Axis 1.x, an end-of-life Java-based SOAP implementation. The flaw has a CVSS score of 9.8 and can allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable systems. Rapid7 detected exploitation on November 13 in a customer environment running Atlassian Confluence Data Center. The attacker executed hundreds of commands, accessed Confluence’s database using the application’s credentials, and searched for sensitive information. Within four hours of the initial exploitation, the attacker had obtained a service account credential and was querying a production cloud data warehouse. Roughly twelve hours after the first exploit request, the attacker signed in to Microsoft 365 using an integration service account. Rapid7 also cited N-able’s report of attacks against N-central involving a vulnerability strongly correlated with CVE-2026-90436. Both Confluence and N-central require non-default configurations to be vulnerable. Separately, Previdian reported detecting 50 exploitation attempts from 14 IP addresses between November 12 and 19. Its sensor data does not establish whether those attempts succeeded. Apache does not plan
